current_answer: OpenAI has a separate rolling application for active open-source maintainers. Selected applicants may receive API credits for eligible maintenance workflows, but the amount and validity are not universally published; credits may require separate review. This is not a general commercial app inference subsidy. OpenAI for Startups remains a different partner-VC route.

catalogue_card.question: Can an unfunded builder use OpenAI open-source API credits?
catalogue_card.text: Only if the work fits OpenAI’s maintainer programme: active public-project maintainers can apply, but API credits are optional and aimed at maintenance workflows. The issuer publishes no universal amount or expiry. Do not budget them for a commercial app.

summary: Active public-project maintainers can apply on a rolling basis; the form asks for repository, role, importance, Organization ID and intended use.
API credits are optional and separately reviewed; six months of ChatGPT Pro with Codex is a separate benefit for selected applicants.
The existing partner-VC startup route remains separate; a self-funded commercial app should not assume either route pays its API bill.
uncertainty: API-credit amount, validity, geography, award, covered usage and individual account balance remain unknown.
No first-party visitor analytics or applicant outcome are available.
freshness_note: Codex for Open Source programme, application and terms checked 19 October 2026. Other entries retain their own check dates.
